svg.text: The board of XLandlord, after Lizzie J. Magie's 1904 patent
Play runs from MOTHER EARTH (0) right to left along the bottom, then up, across and down.
Between the Chances at 32 and 39 a player may move either way.
Lots: sale price and land rent (+$10 a house)
Luxury ($75 for a card worth 100); Legacy (+$100)
Land held out of use: trespassers go to Jail
Corners: 0 Mother Earth (wages), 10 Jail, 20 Central Park (free), 30 Poor House.
A double is a railroad pass: jump the nine spaces between the next two corners.
